description: This file provides functionality for managing launch agents and interacting with the launchctl system, including executing commands, parsing property list files, and defining data structures for launch agent snapshots.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot
classes.description: A data structure representing a snapshot of a launch agent plist, including program arguments, environment variables, and optional paths, port, bind address, token, and password.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a launchctl command asynchronously with the given arguments and returns the result, including the status and output.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Parses a launch agent plist file at the specified URL to create a snapshot object with its configuration details.
